AC2017 Theorem 1 and proof of Lemma 3 supply the ground-state formula and attainment. SKValue ScalarValueConclusion is the distinct formal interface; no local replay is claimed.

QAOA sections/03-classical-optimization.tex lines 62–121 supplies the positive-curvature tail bound and use of that scalar input. Mesh count N remains distinct from spin size n.

SKFullSupport.lean lines 81–92 and SKValue.lean lines 106–173 give exact selected types. SKSupport/Support/VariationIntegrals.lean lines 152–175 gives a discrete chord derivative; SKSupport/Density/GaussianLogDensity.lean lines 106–166 integrates on the positive half-line. These are source-inspected intermediate formulations, not literal equivalences to every manuscript lemma or replay evidence.

QAOA sections/03-classical-optimization.tex lines 132–218 proves rooted Gaussian realization and first-chaos energy identity; later density/exclusion lemmas give a bounded formula. sections/04-classical-synthesis.tex thm:classical-synthesis and prop:helper-contraction supply seeded synthesis; sections/05-seed-simulation.tex lem:seed-one-echo and lem:seed-gram-induction supply seed removal and energy identification; sections/02-foundations.tex prop:tree-transfer and energy argument supply fixed-word transfer; sections/06-assembly.tex lines 8–53 fixes errors and choice order. These manuscript arguments exceed both retained formal targets.

QAOA sections/07-positive-temperature.tex lines 85–144 defines positive-temperature support endpoint, rescaled PDE and value estimate; lem:eams-finite-step (lines 300–449), lem:eams-positive-continuum (462–532) and lem:classical-strong-limit (549–697) supply separate finite-step, continuum and occupation/energy steps. The source gives an alternative scalar route, not a consequence of the zero-temperature formal interfaces.
